nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Expertly Clear Acne - Treating & Preventing Lotion

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the lotion clears blackheads and breakouts without adding oiliness or clogging pores, and layers well under makeup.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it does not dry them out further and even helped hydration, while others (including one who received it for review) found it not moisturizing enough and better used as a treatment layered under a separate moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as balancing, not accentuating dry patches or oily areas, and effective against hormonal and recurring breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and calmer skin, but there is dissent: one reviewer had minor irritation and one noted the product can feel harsh.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as having improved hydration in her maturing skin over a month of use.

concerns.aging: A single mature-skin reviewer reports improved moisture and general skin quality after a month; no other aging-specific claims appear.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the lotion does not dry out their skin and even feels hydrating; however, several dry-skin or acne-plus-dry-patch reviewers found it insufficiently moisturizing, and one noted it was drying at first before improving by week two.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness in new breakouts and calmer skin overall, with one noting it minimizes redness enough to consider daytime use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits the formula with reinforcing the moisture barrier without dryness or sensitivity, though most others don't discuss barrier function directly.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers describe existing spots and blackheads shrinking or drying up within days, with dark marks and acne scars fading over weeks; one reviewer saw only a small difference on larger pimples and no change in cystic acne on the chin.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority report fewer breakouts and clearer skin within one to four weeks, including hormonal and stress-triggered breakouts; a minority report continued breakouts, one describing a full-year trial that seemed to worsen breakouts (possibly purging) and stopped use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report the product does not add oiliness and controls the T-zone; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Slow to dry before layering makeup

extraits.titre: A good treatment but not moisturizing enough.
extraits.texte: I received this product for my honest review. I do struggle with acne but I also struggle with dry patches on my skin. I've used this product for a little while now but it really is not moisturizing enough. This is more of a treatment than a moisturizer in my opinion.

This moisturizer works great for my oily skin. I've been using it for several months now and I can definitely see the results! This moisturizer (paired with a targeted serum from the same product line) helped to clear my complexion and reduce amount of blackheads dramatically. I'm honestly amazed at the results and highly recommend this duo to anyone struggling with acne. The only reason I took a star is the moisturizer leaves my skin a little bit tacky. Otherwise it's amazing - lightweight, quick to absorb and well hydrating at the same time. I honestly love it!

extraits.titre: maybe need more time using it
extraits.texte: After using this product the last few weeks I did notice a small difference in some of my larger pimples on my face. However I continuously had acne throughout the time I used it. The cystic acne I have around my chin did not change. I do see a small difference though. And I plan to continue using it to see if it needs more time for my bad acne

extraits.titre: Makes your skin more even clear
extraits.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I was hesitant to use this as a daily moisturizer because I was worried about my skin drying out and being irritated because my skin is on the dry side despite breakouts and in the past any moisturizer containing acne fighting ingredients would leave my skin not only dehydrated but irritated and just uncomfortable. That was not the case here at all. I first began using one dot of this and mixed with another moisturizer of mine and slowly began just using this. It's a lightweight moisturizer that sinks into your skin effortlessly and reinforces your skin moisture barrier so you don't get those uncomfortable symptoms like dryness or sensitivity. Over time using this it also helps fade any marks or uneveness to your skin you may have, possible due to previous breakouts. It minimizes the appearance of pores and evens out your skin tone all the while fighting and preventing future breakouts! So you end up with smoother and clearer skin. I would use in the morning and it's so lightweight it sinks into your skin immediately without feeling sticky or heavy but also makes you feel moisturized all day. It doesn't cause any irritation and you can wear it under makeup application without any issues as well. I've noticed clearer skin, acne scars fading, my skin more even toned and even brighter after use. I would definitely recommend and already have to family and friends.

The Kiehl's Gently Effective Acne-Treating lotion is exactly what it sounds like: gentle, but it gets the job done. The texture is super unique — it's a soft, clay-like paste that melts into your skin as you massage it in. It doesn't foam up, but it still gives you that satisfying deep-clean feeling. I have combination skin that's sensitive and prone to small breakouts, and using this as a cleanser really helped calm everything down. After a couple of uses, I noticed my skin felt smoother, and no breakouts! It didn't dry me out or leave me red like a lot of acne products tend to. One thing I really like is how calming and clean it feels — there's a soft, herbal scent that makes the whole routine feel kind of spa-like. And even after rinsing, my skin feels comfortable and balanced. It leaves my face feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed. It's rare to find a blemish treatment that's this gentle but still works. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine! Highly recommend!

So unfortunately I've always suffered from acne & cystic acne. My skin is also very sensitive so it can be difficult finding products that won't irritate my skin. I absolutely love this product! It helps with future breakouts and also keeps my skin perfectly moisturized without causing it to get oily. I'm obsessed and will definitely be purchasing this.
I tried to use this product throughout the year to see if it improved my skin. Honestly, I felt like it broke me out more... could have been purge, but I did have to stop using.
